overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Louisiana State University (LSU) Tigers baseball team for winning the 2025 NCAA Division I College World Series, the top college baseball championship, by beating Coastal Carolina University. It notes this was LSU's eighth national baseball title and recognizes the head coach and several players who earned conference and All-American honors. It also thanks LSU fans across Louisiana. The resolution asks that formal copies be sent to the coach, the university president's office and the athletic director. The Senate agreed to it on July 21, 2025.
for: Supporters say it honors the hard work of student athletes and coaches and a championship that brought pride to their state.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
